_readme: English source text. Keys are ordered by where they appear on screen. To add a language, copy this file to <code>.json, translate the values, leave the keys alone, and add the language to LANGUAGES in i18n.js. lobbyapp/ui_test.go fails the build if any language is missing a key the others have, so a half-finished translation cannot ship. Placeholders in braces are substituted at runtime and must survive translation unchanged; the words around them may be reordered freely.
namegate.title: LobbyBaz
update.failed: An update ({version}) could not be downloaded: {error}
update.ready: Version {version} is ready. Installing takes a few seconds and reopens the app.
lobby.empty: No rooms yet. Create one and the other player will see it.
room.join.closed: This room is not accepting players
room.title: Room
room.slot.take.note: Move to this seat. Slots 1-5 are Radiant, 6-10 are Dire.
room.kick.note: Removes them and bars them from this room for 5 minutes
net.on: You are on the room's network as {ip}.
net.on.noip: You are on the room's network.
net.failed: Could not get onto the room's network: {error} Press Connect to try again.
net.connecting: Getting you onto the room's network…
net.off: You are not on the room's network yet, so nobody can reach you and you cannot reach the host. Press Connect.
checks.when: Last run {time}, and sent to the server.
profile.title: Your profile
profile.name: Name
err.removed: You are no longer in that room.
lobby.nomatch: No room matches that. Clear the search or pick a different filter.
lobby.col.ping.explain: How far the host is from the relay, not how far you are. A host with a poor connection makes a poor game for everyone who joins them.
lobby.ping.none: The host has not reported their latency yet.
lobby.ping.explain: The host's round trip to the relay — not yours.
room.describe.placeholder: What is this room for? Other players see this.
friends.title: Friends
friends.none: No friends yet. Add somebody by their username.
friends.unavailable: This server has no friends list yet.
chat.nobody: Nobody left to open a conversation with.
chat.party.soon: Parties are not built yet. This tab is here so the chat does not move once they are.
tournaments.title: Tournaments
tournaments.soon: Not built yet. The spec leaves tournaments out of the first release, and this entry is here so the toolbar does not move when they arrive.
namegate.why.join: Pick the name the other players will see. They are about to play with you.
namegate.why.create: Pick the name the other players will see before you open a room.
namegate.why.chat: Pick a name before you say something — nobody can reply to a blank.
auth.norecovery: There is no way to reset a forgotten password. Write it down somewhere you will still have it.
auth.mustaccept: You have to accept the terms to create an account.
profile.local: Not signed in — this name is stored on this PC only.
friends.signin: Sign in to see your friends.
mod.title: Moderation
mod.blurb: Everything here is written down against your name. A reason travels with every action, because somebody will read this months from now.
mod.role.head: Head admin
mod.restricted.line: Currently barred from: {what}. Kicked {n} times this week.
mod.sanction.title: Sanction
mod.sanction.forever: Zero minutes means it does not expire on its own. Choose that deliberately.
mod.reason.placeholder: Reason — what happened, in one line
mod.reason.ask: Why? This is written to the log.
mod.rooms.blurb: Ending a room removes everybody in it. They are told, the same way they are told when a host leaves.
mod.banners.blurb: These appear across the top of everybody's lobby. Written as plain text; no formatting, and no HTML.
mod.banner.title: Headline
mod.banner.empty: An announcement needs something to say.
mod.staff.blurb: Only the head admin can appoint or remove an admin, so the role cannot spread beyond being pulled back.
door.password.keep: Password set — type to change it
door.password.needed: Choose a password, or pick a different door.
pass.title: Change your password
pass.note: Every other device signed in to this account is signed out. There is still no way to recover a forgotten password, so choose one you will remember.
terms.changed: The terms of use have changed since you agreed to them.
mod.staff.appoint.note: They can then sanction, label and close rooms. Only you can undo it.
lobby.nomatch.why: Nothing here matches the search and filters you have set. Clear them to see the whole lobby again.
lobby.empty.why: Nobody has opened a room yet. Open one and everybody else will see it within a couple of seconds.
room.invite.blurb: Pick a friend. They are told about the room and let through its door, even a door that is closed to everybody else.
room.invite.nobody: Nobody to invite yet. Add a friend from the rail on the right, and they will appear here.
room.settings.blurb: Who may come in, what the room is for, and whether it is taking new players. Only you can see this.
step.net.not: Not on this room's network yet
step.game.detail: Dota opens on this PC and finds the host over the room's network.
create.title: Create a room
create.blurb: You will be hosting: the match runs on this PC, and everybody who joins plays through it.
create.name: Room name
create.password: Ask for a password as well
create.note: The door is chosen now rather than afterwards. A room opened to everyone and closed a second later is a second in which anybody can walk in.
settings.title: Settings
settings.blurb: This installation: who the server thinks you are, what the network is doing, and the checks that explain it when it is doing nothing.
